fields.Name: T200 - Open System Entity via Entity Search
fields.Description: Verifies a core system/MJ entity (e.g. Users or AI Prompts) can be found via the Data Explorer sidebar 'Search entities...' box and that its grid loads.

InputDefinition.goal: After logging in, use the left sidebar 'Search entities...' box to find a SYSTEM/MJ entity: click the search box, type 'Users' (or 'AI Prompts'), then click the matching system entity node in the results (do NOT expand the entity group/chevron). Verify the entity's grid loads - showing rows, or a valid empty-state for sparse system entities. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait patiently, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A system/MJ entity (e.g. Users or AI Prompts) was found via the sidebar 'Search entities...' box and selected
The entity's grid loaded - showing rows OR a valid empty-state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
